headline: On November 24, 1973: Autobahn speed limit imposed
captionCards: Speed limit lasted only four months
Only time a nationwide speed limit was enforced on the Autobahn
instagramCaption:
Autobahn hits the brakes in 1973.

Germany introduced a national speed limit on its federal motorways due to the oil crisis. The measure lasted just four months. The system, known as Bundesautobahn, is Germany’s controlled-access highway network. A surprising detail: the literal translation of Bundesautobahn is 'Federal Auto Track'.

This temporary restriction marked the only time in history that a nationwide speed limit was enforced on the Autobahn.
